h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bardhaman

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bardhaman

items.pText: Bardhaman is a university town in the middle of one of West Bengal's main rice-growing districts. Its schools, colleges and residential neighbourhoods have more open ground than the Kolkata suburbs, and buyers here often ask for something different from the usual swing-and-slide set. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our Vasai factory, about 1,610 km away, and delivers it by road for installation by our team or a dealer.

Our own design team created the Funplay Originals range, and several of its collections draw on games Indian children have always played. A school can put a familiar game like hopscotch or a board game into a sturdy outdoor structure, with no instructions needed. These pieces get groups of children playing together, which teachers usually want during break time. We also make the standard CoreCraft pieces, so a school can mix both on one layout.

items.a: Play structures designed by our own team, many inspired by Indian games and nature. They are made at our Vasai factory with the same materials and warranty as our CoreCraft range.

items.q: Can a school mix Originals and standard equipment?
items.a: Yes. Many schools pair one Originals structure with swings, slides and see-saws from CoreCraft. We plan all the pieces on one layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

items.q: Do you install playground equipment in Bardhaman?
items.a: Yes. We send the equipment by road from Vasai and install it with our team or a West Bengal dealer, grouted or self-standing depending on the ground.
